name: real-pi-session-260k
description: Real PI session captured during Epic 3 spec review. ~283k estimated tokens, 402 messages, 5 turns (4 closed, 1 open), 0 chunks. Very coarse turn granularity — turns 2 and 3 are ~111k and ~120k tokens respectively. No smooth/chunk/placeholder artifacts exist yet.
notes: Turn granularity is very coarse — PI groups all messages in a single user-prompt-to-next-user-prompt cycle as one turn. This means band allocation works with 4 units, not dozens. Compact behavior will be very different from synthetic fixtures.
